## Findings
- claim-1: The source states the lower-adjoined minimal generating set \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]
- claim-2: The source gives the antipode formula \(S(s_\lambda)=(-1)^{|\lambda|}s_{\lambda'}\) and its Hopf-algebra identity. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 702-735]
- claim-3: The inspected right-adjoined passage states only the set \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}\), calls it the conjugate generating set, and says that one could transpose the arguments to prove its minimality. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 833-840]
- claim-4: The inspected source does not state the requested signed equality in \(Q\): \[ [\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}]=(-1)^{|\rho|} [\bar s_{(i+\rho'_1,\ldots,i+\rho'_b,i^{j-b})}]. \]
## Strategy
Let \(A=\Lambda/I_{r,q}\), \(q=n-r\), and \(Q=J_v/A_+J_v\). The intended statement is
\[
[\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}]
=(-1)^{|\rho|}
[\bar s_{(i+\rho'_1,\ldots,i+\rho'_b,i^{\,j-b})}]
\quad\text{in }Q,
\]
for \(\rho\subseteq b^a\), padded to \(a\) parts; \(\rho'_k=\#\{\ell:\rho_\ell\ge k\}\) is padded to \(b\) parts, and \(i^0\) is omitted. For \(\rho=\varnothing\), including \(a=0\), both shapes are \(i^j\).

Inspected source: [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 667-700] gives only the tensor reduction
\[
\mathrm{Reduce}_{\varphi}(\nu)
=(-1)^{|\nu_B|+1}(1\otimes\bar s_{(\nu_B)'})
\]
and derives it from the Hopf identity; [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 702-735] states the antipode/Hopf identity. Neither bounded passage states the displayed equality in \(Q\).

The right-adjoined passage [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 833-840] states only
\[
\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}
\]
and says that one could transpose the arguments to prove minimality. It does not state the signed equality.

## Gaps
No supplied bounded source passage states the requested rectangular signed equality. A complete fixed-literal/formula audit of the full source SHA-256 `267a2f5eeae54137af99793e84d5293ec688e854ffff662ddd3a27b1334e2bbd` was not supplied, so whole-source omission cannot be asserted.

Mathematically, the required map from the full-coordinate \(\operatorname{Lin}_\varphi\)-row identity to
\[
\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}-(-1)^{|\rho|}
\bar s_{(i+\rho'_1,\ldots,i+\rho'_b,i^{j-b})}\in A_+J_v
\]
has not been given. Nor have explicit coefficients
\(F_{\rho,\sigma}\) for \(\sigma\subsetneq\rho\). The graded-kernel presentation does not provide these coordinates.

Thus this source certificate, and the universal displayed equality, remain unresolved.

## Next
Supply either (i) a bounded source passage stating the exact equality, or (ii) an explicit integral derivation of the required \(F_{\rho,\sigma}\)-identity from the full-coordinate Hopf row relation.
